source_text: Accipit lapidem capiti; somniat scalam a terra in caelum, angelos ascendentes et descendentes, Dominum innixum.
pass_a_gloss: Takes stone for-head; dreams ladder from earth into heaven, angels ascending and descending, Lord leaning.
pass_b_english: [[He takes a stone for his head >> Bible:Genesis 28:11]]; he dreams [[a ladder from earth to heaven, angels ascending and descending, the Lord leaning upon it >> Bible:Genesis 28:12-13]].
